findings.text: the Newton polish duplicates the stationary-point polish the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:703 and nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1590 rather than extending it; only the grid sign-change seeding is a new capability, so the finder is a partial fork.

the legend handles are hand-built Line2D objects from DEFAULT_INK constants where the replaced implementation deliberately captured the draw_nulls artists, so a change to the marker vocabulary silently desynchronises the legend from the panel marks.

the merge-path and axis-component claims rest on assertions that only run inside an ad-hoc log (component-check-final.log) and its measure.py producer has no test, so a regression in the connectivity logic would not redden any gate.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the five commits 2eb4799d9..511f9dcc1 against base 52702d307482ec0f35e0276e98c21c3a81d1cc91; a prototype finder plus its test, three measurement scripts, a rewritten figure renderer, the SVG and two documents, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source done_when names a stationary-point census at both offsets, contour panels replacing tie-pair-current-gap.svg, and a per-output verdict with the responsible rule at file:line; the manifest records stationary-delivery-gate.log 2 passed EXIT=0 and the receipts carry every claimed figure.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal asks for an independent topology of the census tie state with a verdict on the read's axis, admitted X-point and booked support; docs/research/tie-pair-topology.html:1-86 delivers a three-null census, a merge-path order and a per-output verdict table.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the source manifest at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261020T063628565128-tie-pair-topology/manifest.md; it states the analytic gate passed with the red saddle-removal control, names its logs and receipts, and declares no suite arms owed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source brief grants six paths; git diff 52702d307482ec0f35e0276e98c21c3a81d1cc91..511f9dcc100fb299ddcbb387168b19c00f112777 changes only files inside those paths and edits no test or kernel.py.

justifications.durability: scripts/prototypes/tie_pair_topology/test_stationary.py:25-51 fails with EXIT=1 when the analytic saddle is removed (stationary-negative-control.log), but the merge-path and component logic in measure.py and component_check.py has no test.
justifications.evidence: exports/refined/measurement.json reproduces booked 128.4162487596/129.7308813507 A on cells 263,265,266,267 and read-rule-probe.log carries the ranking margins, though the gate itself asserts only the finder and not the research numbers.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/tie_pair_topology/stationary.py follows the prototype idiom and carries no forbidden name, but render_tie_pair.py:346-393 hand-builds legend handles where the replaced code captured the draw_nulls artists.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/tie-pair-topology.html:470-521 records every in-vessel stationary point with type, position, flux and persistence plus the merge path, matching the measurement receipt at exports/refined/measurement.json.
justifications.reuse: scripts/prototypes/tie_pair_topology/stationary.py:41 polishes roots with scipy.optimize.root, re-implementing the repository's seed polish at nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:703 and nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1590 without extending either, though the grid search itself is not owned.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 52702d307..511f9dcc1 touches only docs/research, docs/evidence/fragments, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/tie-state-current-gap and scripts/prototypes/tie_pair_topology, every one a granted path.
